ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there are two left and right distribution maps of ice and snow cover on Greenland Island; white indicates the ice and snow covered area. The left image is labeled July 8, 2012, and the main body of Greenland Island is largely white, indicating that the range of ice and snow cover is very large; the right image is labeled July 12, 2012, and the white area is obviously reduced, indicating that the ice and snow melted sharply in a short time. Then reason: After a large amount of land ice and snow on Greenland Island melts, the meltwater enters the ocean, which will cause sea level to rise; sea level rise will submerge coastal lowlands, causing the sea area between the island and the North American continent to expand. Therefore, the distance between Greenland Island and the North American continent will increase.

method.method_draft: 先从图像入手：左图标注为2012年7月8日，格陵兰岛主体有大面积白色冰雪覆盖；右图标注为2012年7月12日，白色覆盖明显缩小，说明短时间内冰雪急剧融化。再读题干，白色代表冰雪覆盖区，问题问这种急速融化会使格陵兰岛与北美洲大陆的距离如何变化。运用地理规则：陆地冰雪大量融化会使融水进入海洋，导致海平面上升，沿岸低地被海水侵占，岛屿与大陆之间的海域范围扩大，因此二者距离增大。
